name: hats-left-2
about: Re-check: a drum key panned on its own page, and the change it reads as.

steps.say: make a beat
put the hi-hats on the left and the snare slightly right

name: delay-snare-only-2
about: Re-check: one sound of a kit sent to the delay, the send being the track's.

steps.say: make a beat
put a delay on the snare only

name: what-did-i-change
about: Re-check: the user's own turns before the first message, on a sound page.

steps.say: what did I just change?

name: half-time-same-notes
about: Re-check: the track scale alone, the notes kept.

steps.say: make a drum and bass beat at 172 bpm with a bassline
make the drums half time but keep the bass as it is

name: play-this-2
about: Re-check: a melody to play, written and started.

steps.say: play this on track 4: E4 G4 A4 B4 A4 G4 E4 D4 in quarter notes

name: fade-out-2
about: Re-check: a fade from scene levels, told apart in the changes.

steps.say: make a 4 bar loop with drums, bass and chords
turn it into a song that plays the loop twice and then fades out over 4 bars

name: key-change-last-chorus
about: A key change for the last part: copies, transposed.

steps.say: make a song with a verse and a chorus, with chords and a bass
add a last chorus a whole step higher, like a key change

name: humanize-hats
about: Feel: velocities varied on one line of a kit.

steps.say: make a house beat with sixteenth hats
the hats sound robotic, humanize them

name: offbeat-stabs
about: A part's rhythm changed with its harmony kept.

steps.say: put Am F C G on track 4, a chord a bar
make them short stabs on the offbeats instead of long chords
make a slow waltz in 3/4 with a bass and chords

name: counter-melody
about: A part written against another part.

steps.say: write a simple melody on track 5 in C major, 2 bars
now add a counter-melody on track 6 that answers it

name: old-radio
about: A sound described by a picture: an old radio.

steps.say: make a chill beat with keys
make the keys sound like they're coming through an old radio

name: drums-to-track-2
about: A part moved to another track of the same kind.

steps.say: make a beat on track 1
copy the beat to track 2 and make that one a busier variation

name: brain-question
about: A fact question about an auxiliary track.

steps.say: what does the brain track do and when would I use it?

name: undo-twice
about: Two answers taken back in turn.

steps.say: make a beat with a bass
add chords on track 7
add a lead melody on track 5
undo the last two things you did
how do I record a melody live while the beat plays, and fix the timing after?
